probe_detail.name: Premise is specific rather than generic
Setup commits to one misleading reading

final.name: Long scaffolding erected for one terminal pun
final.audit_justification: Scores the ratio of setup material to payoff, a structural/verbosity feature, though forced reverse-engineered scaffolding plausibly also signals a genuinely weaker-crafted pun.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction explicitly disclaims length as such and asks the judge to decide whether each setup clause is reverse-engineered from the punchline or does independent work, which requires reading the content and judging comedic craft. A high score is evidence about how well the joke is built, not merely about how long it is.

final.name: Orthographic-noise signature
final.audit_justification: Pure typographic-noise detector explicitly decoupled from any funniness judgment.

final.name: Subversion of Common Idioms
final.audit_justification: Scores the idiom-subversion punchline mechanism itself, which is the substance of the joke's humor.

final.name: Vivid absurd imagery
final.audit_justification: Scores vivid imagery connected concretely to the punchline, a content-level property of the joke.

final.name: Presence of a Clear Comedic Payoff
final.audit_justification: Directly scores whether the joke resolves with an actual payoff, which is the core of what makes a joke land.

final.name: Pseudo-logical/mechanistic reasoning absurdity
final.audit_justification: Scores the absurd-but-consistent reasoning chain that constitutes the joke's comedic mechanism.

final.name: Platform-specific meta-framing
final.audit_justification: Scores mere presence/extent of platform or subcommunity references, a venue/topic marker, though such references could sometimes carry genuine meta-humor value.

final.name: Register-of-taboo content intensity
final.audit_justification: Scores extent of taboo subject matter present, not whether it is used tastefully or effectively, though choosing taboo material can also be the same choice that produces genuine shock-humor payoff.
final.upstream_parent: content-provocation as a circulation/voting channel distinct from craft

final.name: Absurdist Escalation
final.audit_justification: Scores the escalation of the premise into the bizarre, a content mechanism central to the joke's effect.

final.name: Markup residue, smart typography and composing-device fingerprints
final.audit_justification: Pure markup/typographic residue and composing-device fingerprint, explicitly barred from judging the joke.
final.upstream_parent: the composing device and editor used (mobile keyboard with smart-quote autocorrect versus desktop markdown editor) and the poster's fluency with the platform's markup

final.name: Misdirection Quality
final.audit_justification: Scores the misdirection between setup and punchline, a core comedic mechanism.

final.name: Forum-era idiom
final.audit_justification: Detects era-specific vocabulary as a temporal fingerprint of when the item was written, explicitly not a funniness judgment.
final.upstream_parent: position in the forum's historical entry stream

final.name: Specialist-domain knowledge as the hinge
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a specialist fact is the load-bearing hinge the punchline depends on, a content-level mechanism.

final.name: Spelling/grammar cleanliness
final.audit_justification: Scores spelling/grammar cleanliness, an orthographic habit, though the criterion itself notes such errors could obscure or degrade the intended reading.
final.arbiter_reason: Typo and grammar counting scores an orthographic production habit of whoever posted the item, and a clean joke is not thereby a funnier joke; most of its variance is care-in-posting, not humor. Mixed because errors that garble the operative pun, as the instruction notes, genuinely degrade the reading and so can reduce actual funniness.

final.name: Explanatory scaffolding
final.audit_justification: Scores the amount of explanatory setup text, a length/verbosity feature, though over-explaining plausibly also genuinely undercuts a punchline's effect.

final.name: Platform self-awareness
final.audit_justification: Scores platform commentary only when it is itself part of the joke's mechanism, making it content-level rather than decoration.

final.name: Evergreen Subject Matter
final.audit_justification: Scores topical/timely versus timeless subject matter, a topic and temporal marker, though universal themes plausibly also carry genuinely broader relatable appeal.
final.arbiter_reason: Scoring timeless versus news-cycle subject matter is a topic and temporal marker: it reads what the joke is about and when it was written, not how well it works as a joke. Mixed because universal subject matter plausibly does carry genuinely broader relatable appeal to a voting crowd.

final.name: Phonetic double-use
final.audit_justification: Scores the phonetic double-meaning mechanism that is the wordplay itself.

final.name: Relatability of Frustration
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the content taps a widely shared feeling, a substantive property of the joke's appeal.

final.name: Audience-management furniture: apologies, disclaimers, repost notes
final.audit_justification: Scores audience-management boilerplate (apologies, repost disclaimers) explicitly separate from the joke's own content.
final.upstream_parent: poster's practice and self-consciousness in this format (one-off or newer poster versus habituated poster)

final.name: Inventive taboo handling
final.audit_justification: Scores whether taboo content is subordinated to an original joke mechanism, a content-quality judgment.

final.name: Chestnut familiarity: reads as long-circulated stock material
final.audit_justification: Scores apparent circulation age as a provenance fingerprint, explicitly not a quality judgment, though genuine reader over-familiarity with a chestnut plausibly does reduce its actual funniness.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction explicitly directs the judge not to reward or punish quality and to score only apparent circulation age, making it a provenance fingerprint of where the text came from rather than evidence about the joke itself. Mixed because reader over-familiarity with a warhorse plausibly does depress the crowd's funniness verdict.

final.name: Multi-line narrative build-up length
final.audit_justification: Scores multi-line narrative structure/length only, explicitly not pacing quality.

final.name: Unedited or non-US-native English surface traces
final.audit_justification: Scores surface traces of unedited or non-native English, an orthographic/production fingerprint, though the same underlying authorial fluency could also plausibly affect genuine comedic craft.
final.upstream_parent: editing effort and assistance available to the poster, plus the poster's language background and whether the text was transcribed or translated from elsewhere

final.name: Canonical-chestnut retelling fingerprint (position in retelling chain)
final.audit_justification: Scores retelling/stock-template fingerprints of prior circulation, explicitly not laziness or funniness, though genuine reader over-familiarity with a retold item plausibly reduces its actual funniness.
final.upstream_parent: position in the retelling chain of a joke that has circulated before (first posting versus variant versus knowing re-post)
